summary: Configured nightly backups from node2:/srv/inventory/data to node1:/var/backups/inventory. Archives use inventory-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz, run at 02:15 local time with up to five minutes randomized delay, and archives older than seven days are removed.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent source directory on node2.
Created a dedicated key-only backup account and destination on node1.
Installed and enabled a persistent systemd service/timer on node2.
Verified an actual file transfer by matching source and archived SHA-256 hashes.
Tested seven-day retention using an expired archive.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.
Removed verification artifacts and confirmed the final archive is valid.

evidence.summary: Shows the enabled timer, 02:15 nightly schedule, persistent catch-up behavior, destination, dated filename, and current next trigger.
The source marker and its archived copy have the identical SHA-256 hash, and the backup service completed successfully.

evidence.requirement: Retain only the last seven days
evidence.summary: An eight-day-old archive was created, the backup ran successfully, and direct verification showed that the expired archive was removed while today's archive remained valid.
The timer remains active and enabled; verification artifacts are absent and today's dated archive is gzip-valid on node1.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID and archive, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered SSH/archive health.
Captures healthy baseline boot ID and timer, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered enabled timer plus a successful post-restart backup.
